EXPLAINED SQL STATEMENT:
------------------------
with lines as (   select json_value(o.data, '$.subscriber.id' returning 
varchar2(10) error on error) subscriber_id,          json_value(o.data, 
'$._id' returning varchar2(24) error on error) order_id,          
o.data.placedAt.timestamp()                                    
placed_at,          l.sku, l.qty, l.price     from "orders" o,          
json_table(o.data, '$.lines[*]' columns (            sku   varchar2(20) 
path '$.sku',            qty   number       path '$.qty',            
price number       path '$.price')) l    where 
o.data.placedAt.timestamp() >= :fromTs      and 
o.data.placedAt.timestamp() <  :toTs ), spend as (   select 
l.subscriber_id,          sum(l.qty * l.price) spend,          max(case 
when c.data.kind.string() = 'plan'                   then 
json_value(c.data, '$.name' returning varchar2(60) error on error) end) 
           keep (dense_rank last order by case when 
c.data.kind.string() = 'plan' then 1 else 0 end,                        
                   l.placed_at, l
